newsitem.title: USA: Mule Canyon Mine pours first gold.
newsitem.headline: Mule Canyon Mine pours first gold.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said Tuesday gold production has begun from the new Mule Canyon Mine, 14 miles east of Battle Mountain.

Mule Canyon is part of the Lone Tree Complex near Valmy, Nev., which includes the existing Lone Tree Mine, the Trenton Canyon Mine and the new Lone Tree Flotation Project currently under construction.

As of November 22, the company said, the first Mule Canyon gold was included in gold dore poured at Lone Tree. This gold resulted from the processing of about 3,000 tons of ore at an average grade of 0.57 ounces per ton.
